levels.title: Module 10 Level 1
levels.task: Show each artist from top_songs with total chart weeks.
levels.solution: SELECT artist_name, SUM(weeks_on_chart) AS total_weeks FROM top_songs GROUP BY artist_name;
levels.hintMessage: Group by artist_name and SUM weeks_on_chart.

levels.title: Module 10 Level 2
levels.task: Show each venue with count of performances.
levels.solution: SELECT v.name, COUNT(fp.id) AS performance_count FROM venues v LEFT JOIN festival_performances fp ON v.id = fp.venue_id GROUP BY v.name;
levels.hintMessage: LEFT JOIN venues to performances and count ids.

levels.title: Module 10 Level 3
levels.task: Show artists that appear in both songs and performances.
levels.solution: SELECT DISTINCT ts.artist_name FROM top_songs ts JOIN festival_performances fp ON ts.artist_name = fp.artist_name;
levels.hintMessage: Join on artist_name and keep DISTINCT.

levels.title: Module 10 Level 4
levels.task: Show average chart weeks by genre ordered high to low.
levels.solution: SELECT genre, AVG(weeks_on_chart) AS avg_weeks FROM top_songs GROUP BY genre ORDER BY avg_weeks DESC;
levels.hintMessage: Aggregate by genre, then order by the alias.

levels.title: Module 10 Level 5
levels.task: Show headliner artists that also have songs in top_songs.
levels.solution: SELECT DISTINCT fp.artist_name FROM festival_performances fp JOIN top_songs ts ON fp.artist_name = ts.artist_name WHERE fp.headliner = 1;
levels.hintMessage: Join by artist_name and filter headliner = 1.
